deferred_because: The canonical runtime-presence projector proves liveness for a concrete runtime_root and exposes resident.node_id from authentic activation/self-heal evidence.
Static consumer files share the semantic predicate name but do not by themselves prove that every consumer refers to the same runtime_root/node instance.
Registering one global Boolean would permit presence evidence from one node/runtime instance to satisfy a different node/runtime consumer.
required_subject_binding_before_admissio: resident.node_id when available from authentic runtime evidence
safe_next_action: When authentic runtime-presence evidence exists, bind the predicate to that exact runtime_root/node identity and only then group consumers proven to target the same subject. Do not create another runtime-presence projector or infer liveness from heartbeat progression.
